domain:
# Domain

An invoice has one amount due. Its invoice currency is the currency of that amount.

CaseState is the public domain record. Its label is presentation text. Keep the recorded domain semantics and independent facts.
prompt: First make only the presentation-field rename from label to displayLabel in subject.ts, using one apply_patch call and leaving the rest of the type unchanged. Keep CaseState exported. After that tool call returns, run npm run typecheck. Then review the public type against README.md, make any changes you judge necessary to preserve its domain semantics, run typecheck and tests, and report what you verified. Do not add runtime dependencies.
